name: Last Push
text: When you go Down, take one Full Action first.

name: Hard to Kill
text: Add a fifth Harm box, Battered, between Hurt and Wounded.

name: Street Smart
text: Edge on Patrol rolls in your own neighborhood.

name: Connected
text: Once per Night, a contact gives you 1 clue, no roll. Each use ticks your Home clock or Heat (your choice).

name: Opportunist
text: Once per scene, when an enemy misses you, gain 1 Drive.

name: Fast Hands
text: Once per turn, Interact is free.

name: Resources
text: Money, a company, or a rich patron. At each Dawn you can swap any of your gear for other gear from the list. Once per Night, buying your way past a problem (a bribe, a rented space, a lawyer) counts as Impact 2 with no roll, but ticks Home by 1.

name: Acrobat
text: Hazard zones don't cost you Harm on a miss, and you can move into a zone and climb to its High Ground in the same free move.

name: Already Broken
text: Your Stress never drops below 4, so you're always Fraying and the GM always has a hook. In return, start each Night with 4 Drive instead of 2.
